Name: Yagisan's Marnie Shop Expanded
Author: Yagichan
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=5]Yagisan's Marnie Shop Expanded[/size]

As your friendship with Marnie and Shane grows, and certain events take place in the valley, Marnie's stock selection will grow.
Stock availability may vary from day to day. This depends on your daily luck.

[list]
[*] 1 Heart - Marnie: Milk
[*] 1 Heart - Shane: Eggs
[*] 3 Hearts - Marnie: Goat Milk
[*] 3 Hearts - Shane: Duck Eggs
[*] 3 Hearts - Marnie and Shane: Duck Feathers
[*] 4 Hearts - Marnie: Large Milk
[*] 4 Hearts - Shane: Wool
[*] 5 Hearts - Marnie: Large Goat Milk
[*] 5 Hearts - Shane - Visited Ginger Island: Ostrich Egg
[*] 7 Hearts - Marnie: Truffles
[*] 8 Hearts - Shane: Large Eggs
[*] 8 Hearts - Marnie - Community Centre Complete: Auto-Petter
[*] 8 Hearts - Marnie and Shane: Rabbit's Foot
[/list][list]
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][/list][/font][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][font=Verdana]
